12: def _render_page(pdf_path, page, scale):
13:     """Render one 1-based page of a PDF to PNG bytes: ``(png, page count)``.
14: 
15:     Runs only in the short-lived rendering child, never in the agent process.
16:     """
17:     import pypdfium2 as pdfium
18:     pdf = pdfium.PdfDocument(pdf_path)
19:     try:
20:         count = len(pdf)
21:         if not 1 <= page <= count:
22:             return None, count
23:         pg = pdf[page - 1]
24:         try:
25:             width, height = pg.get_size()                 # points; pixels = points * scale
26:             scale = min(scale, _MAX_SCALE, _MAX_RENDER_PX / max(width, height, 1))
27:             bitmap = pg.render(scale=max(scale, 1 / _MAX_RENDER_PX))
28:             try:
29:                 # to_pil() shares the bitmap's buffer, so the PNG has to be written before it goes.
30:                 image = bitmap.to_pil()
31:                 try:
32:                     buffer = BytesIO()
33:                     image.save(buffer, format="PNG")
34:                 finally:
35:                     image.close()
36:             finally:
37:                 bitmap.close()
38:         finally:
39:             pg.close()
40:         return buffer.getvalue(), count
41:     finally:
42:         pdf.close()

5: def split_deliverable(value):
6:     """Accept one basename, plus the two legacy filename-and-instructions forms.
7: 
8:     Do not fish filenames out of arbitrary prose: an ambiguous contract must be
9:     corrected before dispatch, rather than silently waiving the completion gate.
10:     """
11:     lines = str(value or "").strip().splitlines()
12:     if not lines:
13:         raise ValueError("Invalid deliverable: name one file, for example `findings.md`.")
14:     first, *rest = lines
15:     quoted = re.fullmatch(r"`([^`]+)`(?:[ \t]*[:：][ \t]*(.*)|[ \t]*)", first)
16:     legacy_write = re.fullmatch(r"Write `([^`]+)`(?: (under .+)|\.)?", first, re.IGNORECASE)
17:     legacy_bare = re.fullmatch(r"Write ([^\s`]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16})\.", first, re.IGNORECASE)
18:     described = re.fullmatch(r"([^\s/:：`\\]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16})[ \t]*[:：][ \t]*(.*)", first)
19:     if quoted or described:
20:         name, detail = (quoted or described).groups()
21:     elif legacy_write:
22:         name, location = legacy_write.groups()
23:         detail = f"Write it {location}" if location else ""
24:     elif legacy_bare:
25:         name, detail = legacy_bare.group(1), ""
26:     else:
27:         name, detail = first, ""
28:         if any(char.isspace() for char in name) and not re.fullmatch(r"[^`]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}", name):
29:             raise ValueError("Invalid deliverable: put one filename on its own line, in backticks if it contains spaces.")
30:     if (not name or name in {".", ".."} or name != name.strip()
31:             or any(char in '/\\:：`' or ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in name)):
32:         raise ValueError("Invalid deliverable: use a filename, not a directory or absolute path.")
33:     return name, "\n".join(([detail] if detail else []) + rest).strip()

36: def format_deliverable(value):
37:     """Canonical card form: an explicit filename line, then unchanged requirements."""
38:     name, detail = split_deliverable(value)
39:     return f"`{name}`" + (f"\n{detail}" if detail else "")

201:     """Detect active shell syntax while preserving quoted grep/sed patterns."""
202: 
203:     # Shells erase a backslash-newline pair before tokenization.  Reject every
204:     # multiline command up front so the path validator sees what is executed.
205:     if "\n" in command or "\r" in command:
206:         return True
207: 
208:     quote: str | None = None
209:     escaped = False
210:     for char in command:
211:         if escaped:
212:             escaped = False
213:             continue
214:         if quote == "'":
215:             if char == "'":
216:                 quote = None
217:             continue
218:         if quote == '"':
219:             if char == "\\":
220:                 escaped = True
221:             elif char == '"':
222:                 quote = None
223:             elif char in {"$", "`"}:
224:                 return True
225:             continue
226:         if char == "\\":
227:             escaped = True
228:         elif char in {"'", '"'}:
229:             quote = char
230:         elif char in ";&|><`\n$*?[]{}()":
231:             return True
